description: List the sellers behind the monitored x402 endpoints, grouped by domain, with each seller's endpoint count, verdict mix (proceed, caution, avoid, free, insufficient_data, bulk_listing), passing and paid-tested counts, and best grade. Use it to find which providers have trustworthy endpoints, search a provider by domain, or see who has endpoints to avoid. Open one seller's endpoints with seller_endpoints; for a single endpoint use check_endpoint. Read-only and free; the same data as lumierepaycheck.org/sellers, refreshed every few minutes.

includeBulk.description: Include sellers listing thousands of near-identical endpoints (default true)

offset.description: Skip this many sellers, for paging (default 0)

query.description: Part of a seller's domain to search for, e.g. 'weather' or 'x402node.dev'

sort.description: Order: most endpoints (default), most passing, most paid-tested, most to avoid, or by name

verdict.description: Only sellers with at least one endpoint in this verdict (sorted by how many they have in it)

name: list_sellers

forTeams.description: Short note about team plans (per-agent keys, spend limits, audit trail)

paidTested.description: Endpoints where a real test payment was delivered

title: List x402 sellers by verdict
